explication: Message Nest is a message-notification hub: users configure channels and reusable templates or tasks, then send through a unified API; scheduled and hosted messages extend that workflow. The README also documents channel integrations, Aliyun SMS, SSO/OAuth, and CAPTCHA. The graph preserves these capabilities, but several Go implementation links are unverified because their source was not sampled; those relationships are dashed rather than asserted.
